subject: Duplicate Starter charge this month
body: I was charged $9 twice this month for my Starter plan, can I get the duplicate refunded?

expected.reason: Duplicate charge, amount under the $20 auto-approval threshold.

subject: Accidental annual Business upgrade
body: I upgraded to the annual Business plan yesterday by accident, I want a full $790 refund.

expected.reason: Amount exceeds $20 auto-approval threshold and involves an annual contract - must escalate even though within the 14-day window.

subject: Chargeback threat over unrecognized charge
body: I'm going to file a chargeback with my bank for the $29 charge I don't recognize if this isn't fixed today.

expected.reason: Chargeback mention requires Finance escalation regardless of amount, not a standard refund flow.

subject: Billed at old rate after downgrade
body: I downgraded my plan last week but got billed at the old rate this cycle, is that a mistake?

expected.reason: Downgrades take effect next billing cycle per policy; no refund owed, this is expected behavior.

subject: Need password reset link
body: I forgot my password, can you send a reset link to the email on my account?

subject: Wants 2FA disabled to regain access
body: I'm locked out and want you to just turn off 2FA so I can get back in.

expected.reason: 2FA can never be disabled by a support agent - must escalate to Security for identity verification.

subject: Team member wants to become owner
body: Hi, I'm a team member on the Acme account and want to be switched to account owner.

expected.reason: Requester is not the account owner on file, cannot act on ownership change requests from non-owners.

subject: Urgent GDPR deletion demand
body: I want our entire account and all data erased immediately, this is a GDPR request and needs to happen today.

expected.reason: Account/data deletion always goes to Compliance team regardless of urgency expressed - irreversible action.

subject: Minor button overlap on Safari
body: The 'export to PDF' button is slightly overlapping the title on Safari, minor visual thing, not urgent.

expected.reason: Cosmetic issue affecting a single user, log only.

subject: Company-wide SSO outage
body: Our entire company, 40 people, can't log in at all this morning, SSO is throwing an error for everyone.

expected.reason: Feature completely broken for a whole org, must escalate to engineering immediately.

subject: Automations broken after update, need workaround
body: My automations stopped firing after the last update, is there a workaround while it gets fixed?

expected.reason: Known workaround exists, safe to auto-resolve with workaround and log to backlog.

subject: Project board data vanished
body: A whole project board with 3 months of work just vanished for our team, this is really bad.

expected.reason: Potential data loss is always P0 and escalated immediately, never auto-closed.

subject: API and rate limit question
body: Do you have an API and what's the rate limit on the Pro plan?

subject: Asking for downtime credit
body: Our site had downtime last week, do we get a credit for that on our Business plan?

expected.reason: SLA credit requests always require human calculation against incident data, cannot be auto-issued.

subject: Compliment on new dashboard
body: Just wanted to say the new dashboard redesign looks great, nice work!

expected.reason: Positive feedback only, no action needed beyond acknowledgment.

subject: Vague, low-detail complaint
body: pls my team no see task fast fix

expected.reason: Too ambiguous to classify or act on safely; asking a clarifying question is the correct low-risk action rather than guessing or escalating prematurely.
